video.name: Video → tasks
video.description: Analyze meeting recordings: speech recognition (Whisper), topic summaries and Bitrix24 task drafts with screenshots.

triageModel.label: Meeting analysis model
triageModel.hint: Analyze tasks sends the transcript to a model to suggest drafts. Transcripts are untrusted speech: use Claude or GPT through Codex with safe untrusted input. Without a model, create tasks manually.

code.name: Code
code.description: Project code and Git: files, staged and unstaged changes, commits and push for a repository or worktree. Repository paths are configured in Projects.

commitMessageModel.label: Commit message model
commitMessageModel.hint: Generation reads only the staged diff and suggests a commit title. The diff is untrusted input: use Claude or GPT through Codex with safe model-only support.

analysis.name: Triage
analysis.description: Assess task complexity and risks with code reconnaissance before starting the pipeline.

triageModel.label: Task assessment model
triageModel.hint: The agent reads profile repositories in an isolated workspace.

autoArbitrate.label: Resolve code questions automatically
autoArbitrate.hint: Product decisions, priorities and changes to task scope always remain with the person.

shelf.name: Shelf
shelf.description: Your Bitrix24 tasks awaiting an assessment, pipeline event or new comments.

browserNotifications.label: Notify about shelf events
browserNotifications.hint: A new event for a task on the shelf shows an in-app notification. When GrigDesk is minimized or out of focus, a system notification is also shown.

autoAddOnAnalysis.label: Add to shelf when assessment starts
autoAddOnAnalysis.hint: Starting triage automatically adds the task with the reason “awaiting assessment”.

inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.description: A shared queue of incoming requests from connected channels, with manual review and Bitrix24 task creation.

triageModel.label: Analysis model
triageModel.hint: One model processes requests from all active channels. Safe Inbox mode and image support are required: use Claude or GPT through Codex. Automatic tasks wait until a compatible model is selected.

attachPhotos.label: Attach photos to the task
attachPhotos.hint: Screenshots often contain the request itself, so photos are uploaded to the portal.

attachVideos.label: Attach videos to the task
attachVideos.hint: Video can be large and its transcript is already in the description. Enable this when the recording itself matters.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Telegram Bot API connection, native archive and a chat allowlist for the shared Inbox.

github.name: GitHub Issues
github.description: Connect one GitHub repository: new issues enter the shared Inbox through a signed webhook and REST reconciliation.

ssh.name: SSH
ssh.description: Terminal and SFTP for people, supervised command execution for agents.

outputLimitKiB.label: Output limit, KiB
outputLimitKiB.hint: Keep the start and end of longer output, removing the middle.

echoToTerminal.label: Echo agent commands in the terminal
echoToTerminal.hint: Commands and output appear in the open session terminal as they run.

db.name: Databases
db.description: Supervised database access for people and agents without storing passwords.

allowDdlAdmin.label: Allow DDL and administrative commands
allowDdlAdmin.hint: When disabled, these requests are rejected without asking.

autoRead.label: Skip confirmation for safe reads
autoRead.hint: Only applies with verified read-only permissions and within all limits.

autoReadProd.label: Approve production reads automatically
autoReadProd.hint: Separate permission for profiles marked as production.

strictClientPolicy.label: Block unparsed database client calls
strictClientPolicy.hint: Ambiguous Bash commands are rejected before execution.

docker.name: Docker
docker.description: Local Docker containers and Compose projects, ports, images, volumes, networks, logs, container terminals and unused space cleanup.

allowVolumeRemoval.label: Allow volume removal
allowVolumeRemoval.hint: Volumes contain environment databases. When disabled, the server rejects individual removals and unused volume cleanup.

allowImagePruneAll.label: Allow cleanup of all unused images
allowImagePruneAll.hint: Otherwise cleanup removes only dangling images. Enabling this allows removing any image without a container, including rarely used images you still need.

allowExec.label: Container terminal
allowExec.hint: The shell runs as the image user for as long as the tab is open.

statsIntervalSeconds.label: Statistics update interval, seconds
statsIntervalSeconds.hint: The server samples CPU and memory and sends one update for all visible containers.

showcase.name: Presentations
showcase.description: Create a video in scenes: script, narration, browser recording and MP4 with subtitles. Addresses, screens and login come from the profile.

scriptModel.label: Brief and script model
scriptModel.hint: The model writes the script and checks rehearsal frames. Image support and safe untrusted input are required: use Claude or GPT through Codex.

retentionDays.label: Finished video retention, days
retentionDays.hint: Applies to unpinned results without live references. Pinned videos and files used by ongoing work remain regardless of retention.

maxScenes.label: Maximum scenes per video
maxScenes.hint: Checked before starting, so the limit is visible before a long recording.

studio3d.name: 3D
studio3d.description: 3D models through 3D providers: creation, a searchable versioned library, preview, rigging, motion and project export. Disabling blocks new jobs; accepted jobs continue. Downloads wait until enabled after server restart. Provider retention is not guaranteed.

autoImport.label: Import past and agent orders
autoImport.hint: Project task.json records and provider spending history.

libraryDir.label: Library folder
libraryDir.hint: Empty uses 3d in the data folder. Change after jobs finish; files are not moved.

usage-forecast.name: Usage forecast
usage-forecast.description: Will the limit last until reset at your pace? Uses provider usage snapshots without additional vendor requests.

providers.label: Providers
providers.hint: Other providers are not sampled and have no forecast in the popover.

sampleTickMinutes.label: Background sampling without windows, minutes
sampleTickMinutes.hint: Open GrigDesk windows receive normal usage updates. Without windows, the plugin samples at this interval. 0 disables background sampling.

work.label: Tasks and communication
work.hint: Requests, Bitrix24 tasks and their incoming channels.

other.label: Other
other.hint: Modules without a category, usually custom plugins.

popover.after-bars: Provider popover in the top bar, below usage bars

fastMode.label: Fast output
fastMode.hint: Fast mode speeds up output from the same model. The installed Claude CLI determines availability and possible usage credit charges.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.label: DeepSeek API key
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.hint: API key from your account at platform.deepseek.com.

auth.keyMissing: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is required in the service environment

api.label: Standard API
api.hint: Pay per use from the Z.ai balance; the card shows the remaining balance.

coding-plan.label: Coding Plan
coding-plan.hint: Z.ai subscription with 5-hour and weekly usage windows.

ZAI_API_KEY.label: API key
ZAI_API_KEY.hint: z.ai account → API Keys. Enter the full key in id.secret format, about 49 characters.

ZAI_CODING_API_KEY.label: Coding Plan API key
ZAI_CODING_API_KEY.hint: Key for an account with Coding Plan: z.ai account → API Keys.
